thread:
Ravi: Reminder: deploy window tonight 01:30-03:00 UTC for search-service + "search-merge" flag. We'll pin search-service to v5.0 during the TTL reindex. Release notes below.

Priya: Planning a slow ramp for search-merge. We need tight gates because relevance can regress.

Jordan: Proposed ramp: 0.05% -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 20% -> 100%. 10m soak on small steps, 20m on big ones. Manual hold between steps.

Lina: Rollback criteria: errors >1% for 5m OR p95 latency +30% for 10m OR relevance NDCG drop >2% on eval set. Ops should be able to pause ramp immediately.

Ravi: Release note: "search-service pinned to v5.0 for TTL_reindex; search-merge flag staged rollout. Rollback triggers in thread. Ramp owner: @Priya. Abort owner: @Jordan."

Priya: Pin command: `/deploy pin service:search-service version:v5.0 --until=2026-03-26T04:00Z --reason="ttl_reindex"`

deploy-bot: pin applied, job 8844. targets: prod-us, prod-eu. canary slice 8844-C created. :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Add header `X-Canary-ID: 8844` to canary requests. Automation snippet: `if err_rate_5m > 1% or p95 > baseline*1.3 or ndcg_drop > 2%: post_to('#eng-oncall','halt ramp 8844'); halt_ramp(8844)`

Lina: ops-bot can we get canary dashboard + relevance heatmap?

ops-bot: dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/8844. heatmap streaming during ramp. Alerts -> #eng-oncall.

Priya: Sticky QA cohort (internal) at 5% entire window to validate relevance. Do not unpin until reindex finishes + 45m stable. Unpin then `/deploy unpin service:search-service version:v5.0` and finish final step.

Ravi: Any objections? If none we'll proceed tonight.

Lina: :thumbsup: all clear.

Jordan: I'll be on-call to monitor and run aborts if needed.

Priya: I'll own go/no-go at each step and post updates.

Ravi: Thanks team — I'll post final release note and postmortem template after the run.
